text:
Aisha Khan: Drafting RN for the overnight rollout. Two items: model pin rev-2026-04-01 and an updated quantization profile for dedicated nodes. Also need to call out a third-party vector-store rate-limit change that may affect heavy embedters. Can ops + legal confirm wording?

Tom Becker: reading. The quant profile change reduces memory but may add a small latency bump at p99 on long sequences. We should mention expected p99 delta.

Aisha Khan: good point. Proposed copy: 'Expected p99 latency increase on sequences >2048 tokens: ~6-8% during warm-up; steady-state impact negligible.' Thoughts?

Lena Park: that's accurate from perf runs. Also: vector-store provider (VectraCloud) will start 429 throttles for >1200 req/min per key. We must warn customers using high-throughput embedding pipelines.

LegalBot: legal flag  please include the consumer-facing mitigation line and the EU privacy confirmation. Add short actionable next steps for customers.

Aisha Khan: added consumer-facing lines and EU note. Internal announcement snippet for #all-hands: 

```
Heads-up: Tonight's deployment (01:15 UTC) pins model revisions for stability and applies a memory-optimized quant profile for Dedicated. There may be a short p99 increase on very long sequences during warm-up. If you use high-volume embeddings, note VectraCloud will enforce a 1200 req/min per API key rate-limit; consider backoff/retries. No UI changes.
```

Tom Becker: nit: change "short p99 increase" -> "transient p99 increase".

Aisha Khan: updated.

DeployBot: please schedule: 5% canary @01:15 UTC, pause for checks @01:35 UTC, promote to 40% on manual go.

DeployBot: scheduled -> canary 5% @01:15 UTC, hold @01:35 UTC. Link: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1817777777 Reaction: :gear:

OncallBot: oncall notified: night team assigned.

Tom Becker: rollback criteria proposal: auto-hold if error-rate > 1.5% or embedding invalid-rate > 3% on smoke set. Manual rollback if p99 latency +12% sustained over 10m, or any OOM on dedicated.

Lena Park: agreed. Add: abort rollout if 429s from VectraCloud exceed 5% of embedding calls in the canary window.

Aisha Khan: good call. Rollback executor: Tom?

Tom Becker: I can execute rollback. Command to use: `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-25 --note="canary-thresholds"`. I'll post updates to #incidents and ping infra.

LegalBot: approved the RN text; please include the short EU privacy clause and the customer mitigation steps. Reaction: :thumbsup:

Aisha Khan: final preflight checklist:
- legal signoff (done)
- deploybot schedule (done)
- oncall ack (done)
- rollback executor (Tom) (done)
- RN copy ready (done)

Aisha Khan: If no objections, I'll post the internal announcement 2h before the window and let DeployBot run the schedule.

Tom Becker: no objections. Monitoring live metrics during hold.

Lena Park: will watch embedding error rates and VectraCloud 429s.

DeployBot: standing by for `deploybot promote` at hold release or `deploybot rollback` if thresholds are exceeded.

Aisha Khan: thanks all 389 posting to #all-hands T-2h."
